test_pre_update: test inject a callable into a pycolab sprite or drape before its update method executes
test_post_update: test inject a callable into a pycolab sprite or drape after its update method executes
test_PycolabTestCase_assertMachinima: test verify a sequence of game actions produces expected observations with assertMachinima
test_PycolabTestCase_expectBoard: test create a callable that asserts a pycolab game board matches expected ASCII art
test_TestMazeWalker: test a maze-walking sprite that supports injected pre- and post-update callables
